# Every sesam.yml below the main one is part of the config - there is no
# include: to wire it up. Directories holding their own .sesam belong to a
# separate repo and are skipped.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

# --nested gives the directory its own sesam.yml, and the main file does not
# reference it.
mkdir svc
cp token.env svc/token.env
exec sesam add --nested svc/token.env
exists svc/sesam.yml
grep 'path: token.env' svc/sesam.yml
! grep 'include' sesam.yml
! grep 'token' sesam.yml

# Without --nested, a secret lands in the nearest existing sesam.yml.
mkdir svc/deep
cp token.env svc/deep/other.env
exec sesam add svc/deep/other.env
grep 'path: deep/other.env' svc/sesam.yml
! exists svc/deep/sesam.yml

# A hand-written sub-config is picked up by diff and apply.
mkdir app
cp token.env app/key.env
cp app.yml app/sesam.yml
! exec sesam config diff
stdout 'declared/app/sesam.yml'
stdout '\+  - path: key.env'
exec sesam apply
exec sesam config diff
! stdout .

# A separate sesam repo below this one is not part of its config.
mkdir other/.sesam
cp broken.yml other/sesam.yml
exec sesam config diff
! stdout .

# A broken sub-config fails the load, naming the file.
mkdir junk
cp broken.yml junk/sesam.yml
! exec sesam config diff
stderr 'junk/sesam.yml'
rm junk

# A leftover include fails with a hint instead of a schema error.
cp sesam.yml sesam.yml.bak
exec sh -c 'printf "  - include: svc\n" >> sesam.yml'
! exec sesam config diff
stderr 'include is no longer supported'
cp sesam.yml.bak sesam.yml

# A rewrite from the audit log keeps each secret in its sub-config.
cp broken.yml sesam.yml
exec sesam config reset --force
stderr 'wrote it fresh'
grep 'path: token.env' svc/sesam.yml
grep 'path: key.env' app/sesam.yml
! grep 'token' sesam.yml
exec sesam config diff
! stdout .

-- token.env --
TOKEN=hunter2
-- app.yml --
secrets:
  - path: key.env
-- broken.yml --
this: is: not valid yaml at all
